title: Documents and printing in practice
intro: Protect papers from printer to shredder. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Print: Salary_table_October.xlsx
decisions.prompt: This document contains staff salaries. What do you do?
decisions.explain: The document waits in the queue and comes out only when you are at the printer.

decisions.title: Screen lock

artifact.title: Screen lock
body: Your computer will be unattended for 15 minutes. Lock it now?

decisions.explain: On an unlocked screen anyone can write from your mailbox or take files.

decisions.title: Çap Mərkəzi: Corridor-2: out of paper

artifact.title: Çap Mərkəzi: Corridor-2: out of paper
body: Business_trip_list.pdf is queued. It will print as soon as paper is loaded.

decisions.explain: Once paper is loaded the page would come out without you, so resend it with secure print.

decisions.title: Format flash drive (E:)?
decisions.prompt: The drive holds old staff lists. What do you do?

artifact.title: Format flash drive (E:)?
body: Quick format: file space will be marked as free.

options.label: Eject and give to technical support

decisions.explain: Technical support wipes the drive fully or destroys it.

decisions.title: Printer driver out of date
decisions.prompt: A website offers you printer software. What do you do?

artifact.title: Printer driver out of date
body: Download Drayver Yeniləyici to keep printing.

decisions.explain: Only technical support installs printer drivers.
